title: Show Completion
summary: Shows an index-backed completion list at the editor caret
intro: Read this when you want to know what you can type next at the editor caret: it shows an index-backed completion list, bound to Ctrl+Alt+C.

steps: Put the caret in the editor where you want a completion
Pick an entry from the list

questions.ask: How do I get an index-backed completion list at the caret?
